title: Arthur742Ramos/NagataFactoriality
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of Nagata's factoriality theorem for noetherian integral domains. It proves that unique factorization descends from a localization when every denominator is a finite product of prime elements, packages the specialization to submonoids generated by sets of primes, and demonstrates the method with a Nagata-based polynomial UFD theorem.

review.reason: Lean and Mathlib formalization of Nagata's factoriality theorem for noetherian domains.
